messages:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up — Ashwood Labs just sent the open-weight onboarding form. Main asks: hosting vs download rights, 30d embargo before public listing, and permission to serve quantized variants in Dedicated. I flagged legal + infra.

mike-legal: Can you paste the license they attached? if it's plain Apache-2.0 it's usually fine, but any addendum that restricts redistribution will be a blocker.

sarah-pm: They specifically requested a co-announcement with our cloud SI partner during the embargo lift. Want timeline: embargo start = sign date + 14d for verification? Ashwood asked for 30d though.

jordan-ops: From infra POV: hosting ok. For downloads we need provenance metadata + signed redistribution addendum. Also call out KMS/HSM requirements for on-prem customers — partner must accept key gating for private deploys.

ethan-eng: Quantized weights are fine on our runtime (we support q4_0, q4_k_m, q2*). We do need a redistribution clause that permits serving quantized variants and rolling our quantized binaries in Dedicated. If they try to ban "recompilation/derivative" we need clarity.

mike-legal: They sent a short note: "Apache-2.0 + model-card addendum (no-derivatives clause)" — that no-derivatives language is incompatible with redistribution/serving. I'll propose an addendum snippet that preserves attribution but allows distribution for hosting/serving. Drop mock text below.

mike-legal: ```
Redistribution Addendum (draft):
The Model Provider grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host, serve, and distribute the Model and Derivative Works of the Model (including quantized or compiled variants) for the purpose of providing inference services and downloads to Redwood customers, subject to attribution as specified in the Model Card. This license does not permit sublicensing beyond the distribution modes agreed in a signed Marketplace Listing Addendum.
```

anna-partnerships: Thanks — that looks reasonable. I'll send to Ashwood and ask them to remove the "no-derivatives" phrase or accept this addendum.

integrations-bot: Checklist reminder: confirm export control classification, add provenance entry, upload model-card to partner bucket, run eval harness (smoke tests) before embargo lift.

sarah-pm: If Ashwood accepts, propose: sign + 30d embargo (partner wants marketing build), smoke tests in week 1, legal sign-off week 2, marketplace listing scheduled on day 31. @mike-legal @jordan-ops ok? :thumbsup:

mike-legal: +1

jordan-ops: +1 on ops side, will reserve a Dedicated slot for canary serving during embargo window.

anna-partnerships: Great — I'll ping Ashwood with the addendum and timeline. Will post updates here.
